cases.description: Exact task, payload, caller, audience, and commitment are accepted.
An unknown critical protected-header extension fails closed.
An authorization-changing claim without its protected marker and crit entry is rejected.
A protected marker and crit entry without the matching claim is rejected.
The required audience claim is absent.
A valid token for another service cannot be redirected.
The required authenticated-caller binding is absent.
The transport-authenticated caller must match the signed caller.
An action token cannot omit its authorized task while retaining a payload binding.
A token cannot authorize a different AdCP task.
An action token cannot omit its payload hash while retaining a task binding.
A token cannot be replayed over different downstream task arguments.
A monetary operation requires a signed commitment ceiling.
A commitment claim without currency is malformed.
The service-computed currency must match the signed currency.
A commitment claim without a finite non-negative amount is malformed.
The service-computed amount cannot exceed the signed ceiling.
An iat beyond the allowed clock skew is not yet valid.
An nbf beyond the allowed clock skew is not yet valid.
The required expiration bound is absent.
An expiration beyond the allowed clock skew is rejected.
The required replay identifier is absent.
An empty replay identifier is invalid.
A previously consumed (iss, aud, jti) tuple is rejected.
A modified compact-JWS signature is rejected.
An explicit zero-cost ceiling authorizes a verified zero-cost operation.
A zero-cost authorization cannot be widened to a positive commitment.
